ProphecySummary: In a valley of very dry bones, Ezekiel prophesied and watched them come together, receive breath, and stand as a vast army. God explained it plainly: the whole house of Israel, cut off in exile, would be opened from its graves and brought home by His Spirit.
Fulfillment: The return from exile under Cyrus was its first fulfilment, and the Spirit giving new life in Christ is its deeper one. Many also look for a fuller national and spiritual restoration still to come, which is why this prophecy is best marked as begun but not finished.
RelatedEvents: Cyrus's Decree and Return from Exile; Pentecost
